1615.summary: The class discusses the geographical and spiritual changes in Israel for temple worship in the age to come, focusing on Ezekiel's vision of the Holy Oblation and the temple's layout. It contrasts the faithful sons of Zadok with the unfaithful sons of Levi, emphasizing the importance of moral integrity for those who will worship in the future temple.

1616.summary: The class discusses the roles of the Levites and the sons of Zadok in the future kingdom, emphasizing the distinction between those who remained faithful and those who did not. It focuses on the faithful's ability to minister directly to God in the temple, contrasting with the mortal Levites' role in ministering to the people.
